g.aria-label: Kantorovich–Rubinstein W₁ Duality and Lipschitz Critics
WGAN (2017): Clamp w ∈ [−c, c] After Each Update
Enforces κ-Lipschitzness, but restricts weights to ±c
Soft unit-slope constraint; 2-sided GP creates barrier at q = p
Bounds each layer Lipschitz constant ≤ 1 via power iteration
W₁(p, q) = sup_{‖T‖_Lip ≤ 1} { E_p[T] − E_q[T] } keeps unit slope at all distances
